scope: Temporal source dates, controls, counts, full row-period zeros and selected/reference cohorts; no build, deployment or runtime edits.

realData.cohort: all observed independent animal public-marker neighbors, without active UFO filtering (read-only reference probe; not the default UI cohort)

findings.issue: Empty annual timelines return before displaying known date-range exclusions. A cohort made solely of cross-year ranges appears as no timing records instead of reporting excluded intervals.
findings.fix: Append date coverage/policies even with zero cells; distinguish no assignable records from missing timing data.

findings.issue: Legacy Reports over time still aggregates representative row.year (start year), while new heatmaps correctly exclude cross-period intervals.
findings.fix: Label legacy series Recorded start year or clearly disclose its retained start-year grouping.

boundaries: Craft chronology uses the animal marker date. Active UFO filters select eligible neighboring context; matched controls never enter observed chronology.

Zero cells exist only in the crossed observed label/period domain, with unknown dates and cross-period intervals separately accounted; no continuous-surveillance or population-rate denominator is asserted.

countryReleaseReview.method: Read-only country builder validation (write_outputs=False), direct frozen-field comparison, staged manifest/output hashes and release inventory checks
countryReleaseReview.originalNineFields: byte-decoded field equality for every original row in original order; no duplicates added
countryReleaseReview.pins: Frozen projection/detail hashes and seed sha plus per-record canonical hash joins validated by read-only builder
countryReleaseReview.publicPrivacy: New projection appends only country strings; public provenance contains roles, hashes and byte counts, without local paths, coordinates or narratives
